free_text_notes.physician_note: 79-year-old man with prior TIA, type 2 diabetes, admitted 5/11 with left MCA ischemic stroke with mild right hemiparesis. MRI confirmed small infarct; no hemorrhagic conversion. 5/18 11:00: New right arm drift at 13:00 (NIHSS up from 2 to 5); repeat imaging ordered. The patient receives home care visits twice a week for personal care. This existing service was confirmed as still in place and the home-care provider has been notified of the discharge date.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Vitals stable this shift. Tolerating diet. Therapy referral still needs to be sent. The patient experienced mild constipation during the stay. This was managed with a standard laxative and resolved before discharge. No further action is needed.
